qa_pairs.question: In 2023, is the distribution trend of the consumption willingness of Internet users in Chinese cities of different tiers for in - store services (32.4% in new first - tier cities and 31.4% in second - tier cities are relatively high) consistent with the consumption proportion of food and beverage packages in in - store services (72.4% in second - and third - tier cities and 69.2% in fourth - and fifth - tier cities are relatively high)?
